lto.cozaint_note: Cozaint Certified cartridge prices set by Cozaint. When present, the calculator uses cozaint_cartridge_prices_usd for each LTO generation instead of the market price (cozaint_cartridge_price_usd is the LTO-9 price, kept for older copies of tco.js). Only a person changes these; the monthly agent never does.

market_trend.summary: Hard drive prices stay high after rising about 50% year over year by mid-2026, as AI data centers buy up supply; Western Digital and Seagate say capacity is sold out or fully allocated for 2026. LTO cartridge prices remain roughly flat (DatacenterDisk shows LTO media about +1% over 30 days), and Wasabi raised its pay-as-you-go cloud price from $6.99 to $7.99 per TB per month on July 1, 2026.
